matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the unified actor loss definition in Section 4.2, specifically the inclusion of extra terms (L_div, L_dyn) and inconsistent treatment of L_BC. Finding 1 addresses the critic diversity loss formula in Appendix I.1, Equation (7), which is a different component (critic loss, not actor loss) at a different location. This violates R1 (different locus).

GT2 concerns inconsistent aggregation (mean vs min) of q_values in the EDAC update_actor pseudocode compared to SAC-N and CQL. Finding 1 addresses the critic diversity loss formula (dot product vs cosine similarity) in Equation (7), which is a different aspect of the EDAC implementation. This violates R1 (different specific defect in different material).

pred_verdicts.rationale: This finding correctly identifies a potential discrepancy in the EDAC diversity loss formula (dot product vs cosine similarity) but does not match either ground truth defect.
